Name: MORE Abigail Revised - Seasonal - COMPLETED FESTIVAL OUTFITS
Author: smartichoke
Description:
Hi! I loved [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9838?tab=description]stanloona420's design for short haired Abby[/url] so much that I wanted to complete the image set for my own game. It functions exactly the same as their file, so follow their instructions and use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450?tab=description]Poltergeist's Seasonal Outfit[/url] mod to use the files.

THIS IS NOT A MOD, THIS IS JUST THE IMAGE FILES. You will need to replace the images within another mod to use them.

You WILL ALSO NEED to download stanloona420's file to complete the set. I did not include them in my own. THESE OUTFITS ARE ONLY THE [u]FESTIVAL[/u] OUTFITS THAT ARE NOT INCLUDED IN STANLOONA420'S FILES.

[size=3]Now includes 2 versions![/size]

[list]
[*]The sprites in V1 are visually matched to the style that stanloona420 used in their files.
[/list]
[list]
[*]The sprites in V2 are color matched to the portraits along with some personal preference edits. They are also noseless. There are additional files that contain the noses that can be configured in if you are using Poltergeist's Seasonal Outfit mod! This also includes sprites for the seasonal outfits for consistency.
[/list]
Let me know if there are any inconsistencies or issues! I haven't had a chance to do a super in depth look within the game and all of the cutscenes to make sure everything looks right.
